notes.title: Assessment submitted
notes.body: You submitted the Amazon assessment today, three weeks ahead of the 2 December expiry, so the Launch application is now complete and sitting with Amazon. Next, if they move, is a recruiter interview, then a writing exercise, then a four-interview panel. - INSEAD's session recap puts that whole process at four to six weeks, so chase nothing before mid-December.
acted: Amazon Launch online assessment: To-do -> Done
